notes: Official user-guide lists shell + pager builtins with aliases.
Some pager commands appear in the binary menu but are abbreviated in the public guide (/help, /find, /jump, /timeline, /dashboard, /tasks, /queue, /recap, /share, /debug, /gboom).
/auto only appears when auto permission-mode feature is enabled.
/memory /flush /dream require memory enabled; /remember is always available.
/goal appears when goal mode is enabled for the session.
Skills with user-invocable:true also appear as /skill-name (not listed here).
1.0.0 net-new vs academy 0.2.112 pin: /delete primary; /undo alias for /rewind; /agents-dashboard alias for /dashboard; /timeline documented as fullscreen-only; /feedback report pane.

Binary census follow-up (1.0.0 aarch64 strings + menu labels): /cd [path] is a real shell/menu command (Change the working directory for new agents) even though it is not a ### heading in 04-slash-commands.md.
Shell-advertised /hooks-list|/hooks-trust|/hooks-add|/hooks-remove|/hooks-untrust remain real; pager folds most into /hooks modal (see 10-hooks.md).
Binary strings alone are noisy (path fragments, crypto, crates). Authority order: user-guide headings → product menu labels (name/name + description) → shell Usage: lines → raw strings.

session.framing: Delete the current session's history after confirm. Returns to welcome, or to the dashboard when the session was opened from the dashboard. From /resume or welcome list: d then y. Dashboard: Ctrl+X twice or [✗].
Change the working directory for new agents (binary menu label). Usage shape: /cd [path]. Not a ### heading in 04-slash-commands.md on 1.0.0; present in installed binary command table.
Timeline / turn navigation surface (fullscreen only; hidden in minimal mode).

extensions.framing: Opens Plugins tab in extensions modal. Shell also supports subcommands: list, install <source>, uninstall <name>, remove <path>, reload, trust <path> (pager prefers the modal).

Opens Hooks tab in extensions modal. Shell also advertises /hooks-list, /hooks-trust, /hooks-add, /hooks-remove, /hooks-untrust; pager folds most into the modal (trust often still via /hooks-trust or modal Trust).

extensions.gated: shell-advertised; may be hidden from pager slash menu
extensions.framing: Show hooks loaded in this session.

extensions.gated: shell-advertised; may be hidden from pager slash menu
extensions.framing: Trust this project folder for hooks (and unified folder-trust for MCP/LSP).

extensions.gated: shell-advertised; may be hidden from pager slash menu
extensions.framing: Add a custom hook file or directory (Usage: /hooks-add <path> or /hooks add <path>).

extensions.gated: shell-advertised; may be hidden from pager slash menu
shell-advertised; may be hidden from pager slash menu

help_account_ui.framing: With a message, sends immediately. Bare /feedback opens a dedicated report pane (Enter sends, Esc discards).
Show or hide product announcement banners (Usage: /announcements hide|show).
View the full conversation transcript in your pager ($PAGER).
Re-print the last collapsed block, fully expanded. Only available in minimal mode (--minimal).

hidden_easter_eggs.framing: Hidden easter egg (binary label). Mini game-style overlay; needs a graphics-capable terminal (kitty, Ghostty, WezTerm, iTerm2). Not a primary learning path.
Developer/debug scroll diagnostics HUD. Advanced; not for everyday learners.

notes_false: /yolo is a CLI flag alias for --always-approve, not a slash command.
/comp is only a filter prefix example for /compact, not a command name.
